title: Major Incident Manager
description:
Location: Canton, MA

Position Context

The Major incident manager is responsible for managing and coordinating the resolution of high-impact incidents that disrupts critical business services. This role ensures rapid recovery of services, clear communication with stakeholders, and continuous improvement of incident management processes.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

· Deep understanding of ITIL process (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

· Lead and coordinate the resolution of P1 and P2 incidents.

· Drive war room/bridge calls with technical teams and vendors until service restoration.

· Ensure incidents are logged, categorized and prioritized correctly in ITSM tools.

· Communicate incident progress, impact and resolution timelines to stakeholders in real time.

· Prepare and circulate Major incidents Reports or Post Incident Reviews with defined SLAs

· Collaborate with teams to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

· Oversee the incident management protocols and processes and guide the team members accordingly

· Being accountable for resolving the outage via workaround or permanent fix

· Analyze incident trends and provide insights for process improvements

· Contribute to developing and maintaining the Major incident management process, documentation and KPIs

Qualifications and Experience

· Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT or related field

· Certification: ITIL v4 foundational

· Experience with tools like ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or Jira Service Management.
